scope: campaign: starwars_litrpg, Hask Meadow run 2 onward; not a universal Genesis rule; not a Force power
qualification: completed formal Jedi training established by the record (Jedi Knight or above on a validated sheet, or an owner ruling naming an equivalent) AND an explicit entry in granted_to; Force sensitivity alone never qualifies

limits.target: visible, unattended object (not held, worn or carried by a creature; not fixed in place)
limits.out_of_combat: no roll unless meaningful uncertainty exists
never: substituting for an unlearned combat Force power

feature.name: Jedi Fundamentals: Minor Telekinesis
feature.exact_effect: Gently lift, reposition, retrieve or manipulate one visible, unattended object of 10 lb or less within 30 ft. No Force Points. Outside combat, no roll unless the outcome is uncertain; in combat it uses your action. It cannot deal damage, move or disarm a creature, take anything held or worn, stop a projectile, or stand in for a Force power you have not learned. It is not Force Push or Force Pull.
